title.narrative: Promoting public health and social resilience against COVID-19 by strengthening the domestic supply chain of personal protective equipment

description.narrative: The overall objective of the proposed UNIDO project is to promote public health and social resilience against COVID-19 by strengthening the domestic supply chains of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), disinfectants, and hygiene supplies. This project will tackle the goal through upgrading domestic producers, material suppliers, and other relevant public institutions in terms of 1) production capacity, 2) quality, and 3) business resilience <(>&<)> continuity in emergency situations. In the project, the selected domestic producers and material suppliers will receive hands-on capacity building training by the professional trainers designated by UNIDO, based on the initial capacity assessment conducted in the inception phase. The selection of the beneficiary companies will cover both formal and informal businesses and prioritize micro-, small-, and medium enterprises (MSME), which play a pivotal role in Tanzania#s economy. As a part of the capacity reinforcement, necessary equipment for upgrading and enhancing production capacity will be defined and sup plied, where necessary. It has been experienced during the early stage of COVID-19, protective supplies were in a serious shortage everywhere, and it caused a significant problem among health workers and institutions.
